# TSHOW

List the time series settings.

## Syntax

```text
TSHOW.
```

A table with every TSET setting, the period the DATE variables of the active dataset give (if any), and the period the procedures use when they are not told one.

## Example

```text
TSHOW.
```

`statscraft help TSHOW` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
